---
name: event-forecast
description: Adds Azure event normalization, idempotent processing, contextual reassessment triggers, and capacity forecasting.
---

Normalize Resource Notifications, Activity Log, Monitor alerts, and health events into one bounded
event contract. Deduplicate by source event ID and process at-least-once delivery safely. Reassess
only affected workloads and cohorts.

Forecast from aggregated metrics using explicit history window, operational threshold, planning
horizon, confidence, and evidence freshness. State limitations and never claim prediction for
sudden failures without leading signals.
